# BO - credit-slips - An exception is displayed when downloading a credit slip with deleted product

In the BO > Orders > Credit slips page on PrestaShop 8.0.0, an exception is displayed when downloading a credit slip with a deleted product

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16067358/187721189-7277cc31-3955-4f4a-813b-2ebc81261050.png)

_Important: I didn't reproduce the issue with php7.2, thanks @hibatallahAouadni_

## Attendu
The expected behavior is the behavior from PrestaShop 1.7.8.7

I checked with PrestaShop 1787 with php7.2 : behavior is correct.

## Étapes
1. Enable debug mode
2. Create an order from the BO or FO
3. Go to backoffice page BO > Orders > View to look at the order you just created
4. Change the order status to 'payment: accepted', this validates the order
5. Click on 'Partial refund' button and use the interface to 'return the product': this simulates an order where a user is not satisfied with product and returns the sold product, and prestashop creates a refund
6. From the order page, **remove the product** from the order details page 

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16067358/187726147-170e1b65-c9bf-4102-b384-d3b523448bf1.png)

7. Go to backoffice page BO > Orders > Credit slips page
8. Click on "Download Credit slip" for the order
9. See error: exception message

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16067358/187725640-ed07682f-e760-4c0c-a7cf-ecb4a51ab723.png)

10. Click on "Generate PDF file by date"
11. See exception
